items.title: Urbie Green interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: And so he coached Steve Allen on how to do all that stuff.

ctx.x: He’s a good player around New York, and his whole life was dedicated to trying to sound like Benny Goodman and even trying to look like him. He did everything he could to look like Benny, even filing his teeth in a curved shape. And he had all these actions down where he’d lift one leg or whatever when he was playing. And so he coached Steve Allen on how to do all that stuff.
So the Elvis impersonations are not new.
